summary: Sole eyewitness testimony unreliable; unnatural conduct: witness failed to alert police despite proximity to headquarters; delayed reporting to family; uncorroborated motive of money dispute; inconsistent testimony about disclosure to deceased's sister; witness credibility impeached due to contradictions; post-mortem confirmed firearm injury with 60 metal pellets; acquittal granted due to reasonable doubt despite eyewitness account.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellant acquitted.
